newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air Inc taps two banks for loan increase.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air Inc taps two banks for loan increase.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 5 (LPC) - Bankers Trust and Goldman Sachs & Co are approaching the syndicated loan market regarding a $50 to $70 million increase of an existing, $175 million revolving loan for Atlas Air Inc, banking sources said.
The increase will be used for the acquisition of aircraft for the company's fleet, they said.

Structure and pricing of the increased deal will be identical to the existing deal: a 1.75-year revolving portion that converts to a 2.25-year term loan, priced at 250 basis points over the London inter-bank offered rate (LIBOR) during the life of the revolver, 300 basis points over LIBOR during the life of the term loan, according to several lenders.
Bankers Trust and Goldman are soliciting the existing bank group, as well as several lenders new to the company, sources said.
